entries.jp: バーンシュタイン兵
entries.en: Burnstein Soldier

entries.jp: {v:002A}アーネスト、僕たちは間違えているのかな？
entries.en: {v:002A}Ernest, do you think we have made a mistake?

entries.jp: {v:002B}さてな。{p}{v:002C}どちらが間違えているのか、２人とも間違えたのか。{n}いや、それとも２人とも正しいのか‥‥。{p}{v:002D}どちらにしろ、判断するのは後世の連中だ。
entries.en: {v:002B}Who knows?{p}{v:002C}Perhaps one of us is wrong. Perhaps both of us are. Or{n}perhaps we are both right...{p}{v:002D}Either way, future generations will be the judges.

entries.jp: {v:002E}僕は君がうらやましいよ。{n}冷静にそう言い切れる君がね。
entries.en: {v:002E}I envy you. You can say that with such composure.

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:002F}人の気も知らずに。
entries.en: ...{v:002F}You have no idea how I feel.

entries.jp: {v:0030}どうやら腕は衰えていないようだな。
entries.en: {v:0030}It seems your skill has not dulled.

entries.jp: {v:0031}お互いにね。
entries.en: {v:0031}Nor has yours.
...{v:0053}Your Majesty...

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0054}来たか、オスカー。{n}アーネストだけでなく、私も葬ろうと言うのか？
entries.en: ...{v:0054}So you have come, Oscar. Do you intend to bury me{n}along with Ernest?

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0055}陛下‥‥いや、我が友リシャール！{n}もうこんなことはやめてくれ！
entries.en: ...{v:0055}Your Majesty... No, Richard, my friend! Please, put an{n}end to this!

entries.jp: {v:0056}こんなこととは何だ？{n}何をやめろと言うのだ？
entries.en: {v:0056}An end to what? What are you asking me to stop?

entries.jp: {v:0057}昔のあなたはそうではなかった‥‥。{p}{v:0058}思い出してください！{n}まだ我々が士官学校の学生だった頃を！
entries.en: {v:0057}You were not like this before...{p}{v:0058}Please, remember! Remember when we were students{n}at the military academy!

entries.jp: ‥{v:0059}士官‥学校‥？{p}{FC03}{v:005A}そうだあれはまだ我々が出会ったばかりの頃‥。{n}私は身分を隠し‥‥うぅ、頭が‥‥。
entries.en: ...{v:0059}The military... academy...?{p}{FC03}{v:005A}Yes, we had only just met... I was concealing my{n}status... Ugh, my head...
{v:005B}Your Majesty?!

entries.jp: {v:005C}お前を見ていると気分が悪くなる！{n}すぐにこの世から消し去ってくれる！
entries.en: {v:005C}The sight of you sickens me! I shall erase you from this{n}world at once!

entries.jp: {v:0033}あ、リーヴスさんが！？
entries.en: {v:0033}Oh, Reeves-san?!

entries.jp: {v:0034}どうしたオスカー！？{n}そんなことでは、陛下を任せるなど出来ぬぞ！
entries.en: {v:0034}What is the matter, Oscar?! How can I entrust His{n}Majesty to you if this is all you can do?!
...{v:0035}Forgive me.

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0036}お前はそこで、己の弱さを呪っているがいい。
entries.en: ...{v:0036}Stay there and curse your own weakness.

entries.jp: {v:0037}うるさい！{n}我々の勝負に手出しをするな！
entries.en: {v:0037}Silence! Do not interfere in our duel!

entries.jp: {v:0038}ほほぅ、なかなかやるな。{p}{v:0039}以前会ったときも思ったが、{n}お前たちにはみどころがある。{n}このまま死なせるのは惜しい。{p}{v:003A}陛下のために力を貸さぬか？
entries.en: {v:0038}Oh? You are quite skilled.{p}{v:0039}I thought so when we last met, too. You show{n}promise. It would be a shame to let you die here.{p}{v:003A}Will you lend your strength to His Majesty?

entries.jp: {v:003B}できるわけないでしょう！
entries.en: {v:003B}Of course we can't!

entries.jp: {v:003C}い、嫌です！
{v:003D}悪いな。俺が忠誠を尽くすのは隊長だけなんだ。
entries.en: {v:003D}Sorry. The captain's the only one I'll serve.

entries.jp: {v:003E}絶対にイヤ！
entries.en: {v:003E}No way! Never!

entries.jp: {v:003F}悪いけど、僕は学問にしか興味がなくてね。
entries.en: {v:003F}Sorry, but my only interest is scholarly pursuits.

entries.jp: {v:0040}お断りします。
entries.en: {v:0040}I must decline.

entries.jp: {v:0041}ガムランといい、お前といい‥‥。{p}{v:0042}この戦いが終わったら、{n}もう二度とバーンシュタイン王国のために{n}戦いたくねぇぜ！
entries.en: {v:0041}First Gamlan, now you...{p}{v:0042}Once this battle's over, I never want to fight for the{n}Kingdom of Burnstein again!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0043}仕方ない。{n}ならば、ここで果てるがよい！
entries.en: ...{v:0043}So be it. Then you shall perish here!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0044}な、何だと！？{n}まさかこれほどとは‥‥。{p}{v:0045}だが、まだやれる‥‥。{n}我が命つきるまで、まだ‥‥。
entries.en: ...{v:0044}W-what?! I never imagined you were this strong...{p}{v:0045}But I can still fight... Until my life gives out, I can still...

entries.jp: {v:0046}もうやめるんだ、アーネスト！{n}僕は君を死なせたくない！{p}{v:0047}陛下も君も‥‥。{n}僕は親友を殺してまで生きたくはない！
entries.en: {v:0046}Enough, Ernest! I do not want you to die!{p}{v:0047}Neither you nor His Majesty... I do not want to live at{n}the cost of killing my dearest friends!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0048}甘い奴だな、オスカー‥‥。{p}‥‥{v:0049}ならば、勝て！{n}勝って、俺との約束を果たしてみろ！
entries.en: ...{v:0048}You are too soft, Oscar...{p}...{v:0049}Then win! Win, and keep your promise to me!

entries.jp: {v:004A}アーネスト‥‥。
entries.en: {v:004A}Ernest...

entries.jp: {v:004B}陛下を元に戻せるのはお前だけだ。{n}頼む‥‥。
entries.en: {v:004B}Only you can restore His Majesty to his former self. I{n}am counting on you...

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:004C}わかった。
entries.en: ...{v:004C}I will.

entries.jp: {v:004D}これでも私はナイツ・マスターの位をもらった男だ。{p}{v:004E}他の国の腰抜け王と一緒にされては困るぞ！
entries.en: {v:004D}I was awarded the rank of Knight Master, after all.{p}{v:004E}Do not mistake me for one of those cowardly kings of{n}other lands!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:004F}おかしい！？　どうしたんだ、私の体は‥‥。{p}{v:0050}こんな時に‥力が‥‥力がはいらん‥‥。{p}{v:0051}いや、力が吸い取られてゆく！？
entries.en: ...{v:004F}Something is wrong! What is happening to my body...?{p}{v:0050}At a time like this... My strength... I cannot summon{n}my strength...{p}{v:0051}No, my strength is being drained away?!

entries.jp: {v:0076}いよいよ後がなくなったな。{n}そろそろ、終わりにさせてもらうぜ！
entries.en: {v:0076}You're finally out of places to run. Time to finish this!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:008A}さぁ、これでおしまいです。
entries.en: ...{v:008A}Now, this is the end.

entries.jp: {v:0077}もう終わりだよ！
entries.en: {v:0077}It's all over!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0078}あなたの悪事もこれまでです。{n}覚悟してください！
entries.en: ...{v:0078}Your wicked deeds end here. Prepare yourself!

entries.jp: {v:0079}これ以上、人々を苦しめないで。
entries.en: {v:0079}Please, don't make the people suffer any more.

entries.jp: {v:007A}あんたから王位を取り返せば、{n}この国もちっとは良くなるだろうよ。
entries.en: {v:007A}Once we take the throne back from you, this country{n}ought to be a little better off.

entries.jp: {v:007B}我らの崇高な計画を貴様らなどに邪魔されるものか！
entries.en: {v:007B}I will not let the likes of you interfere with our{n}noble plan!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:007D}そうか、その顔‥‥。{n}貴様がすべての計画を狂わせた張本人か‥‥。
entries.en: ...{v:007D}I see... That face... So you are the one who ruined all{n}our plans...

entries.jp: {v:007E}気づいているのだろう？{n}それとも本当に気づいていないのか？{p}‥‥{v:007F}まぁよい。{n}どのみちエラーは正さねばならん！
entries.en: {v:007E}You realize it, do you not? Or are you truly unaware?{p}...{v:007F}No matter. Either way, the error must be corrected!

entries.jp: {v:0080}もう終わりです！{n}あきらめて下さい！
entries.en: {v:0080}It is over! Please surrender!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0081}うっ！{p}{v:0082}この波動は‥‥！？{p}{v:0083}そうか、貴様があのグローシアンか‥‥。{n}この頭の痛みは貴様のせいか‥‥！？
entries.en: ...{v:0081}Ugh!{p}{v:0082}This wave of power...?!{p}{v:0083}I see. You are that Growsian... Are you the cause of{n}this pain in my head...?!

entries.jp: {v:0084}ゲヴェルの造った存在は、{n}グローシアンの前では力を発揮できないって、{n}本当だったんだ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0084}So it was true... Beings created by Gevel can't use{n}their full power in a Growsian's presence...

entries.jp: {v:0085}お前を‥お前を殺せば、我が苦しみも消える‥‥。{n}‥‥お前を殺す！
entries.en: {v:0085}If I... If I kill you, my suffering will end... ...I will kill you!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:005D}なんだこの感覚‥‥。{n}‥私は何をして‥‥。{p}‥‥{v:005E}アーネスト‥‥オスカー‥‥
entries.en: ...{v:005D}What is this feeling...? ...What am I doing...?{p}...{v:005E}Ernest... Oscar...
{v:005F}Your Majesty!

entries.jp: {v:0060}リシャール陛下！
entries.en: {v:0060}King Richard!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0061}そうだ‥私はこの世を‥人間どもを支配下に‥‥。{n}そのために戦っているのだ‥‥。
entries.en: ...{v:0061}Yes... I must bring this world... these humans under my{n}rule... That is why I am fighting...

entries.jp: {v:0063}手間取っているようだな。
entries.en: {v:0063}You seem to be having trouble.
{v:0064}It's them...!

entries.jp: {v:0065}やっぱりこの偽王とゲヴェルには、{n}つながりがあるようだな。
entries.en: {v:0065}So there is a connection between this false king and{n}Gevel after all.

entries.jp: {v:0066}おお、お前たちか‥‥。{n}何故か、力が出ない‥‥、手を貸してくれ！
entries.en: {v:0066}Oh, it is you... For some reason, my strength fails me...{n}Help me!

entries.jp: {v:0067}そのつもりだ。
entries.en: {v:0067}That is the plan.
...{v:0086}Guh... Gah!{p}{v:00EA}...Th-this can't... Why... Ugh...
{v:0087}Your Majesty!

entries.jp: ‥{v:0088}申し訳ありません、リシャール陛下‥‥。
entries.en: ...{v:0088}Forgive me, King Richard...

entries.jp: {v:0089}よくもやってくれたな。{n}死をもって償うがよい！
entries.en: {v:0089}How dare you. You shall pay with your life!

entries.jp: これも運命か‥‥
entries.en: Is this fate, too...?

entries.jp: な、情けない‥‥
entries.en: H-how shameful...

entries.jp: もう立っていられぬ‥‥
entries.en: I can stand no longer...

entries.jp: 最後の最後まで‥‥
entries.en: Until the very end...

entries.jp: 思い残すことはないわ‥‥
entries.en: I have no regrets...

entries.jp: {v:0069}やれるモンなら、やってみなさいよ！
entries.en: {v:0069}Go ahead and try, if you think you can!

entries.jp: {v:006A}そんなこと、させない！
entries.en: {v:006A}I won't let you do that!

entries.jp: {v:006B}貴様らこそ消え去れ！
entries.en: {v:006B}You are the ones who shall perish!

entries.jp: {v:006C}負けないモン！
entries.en: {v:006C}I'm not going to lose!

entries.jp: {v:006D}人間は、負けませんよ。
entries.en: {v:006D}Humanity will not be defeated.

entries.jp: {v:006E}絶対に負けません！
entries.en: {v:006E}I absolutely will not lose!

entries.jp: {v:006F}僕は‥負けない！
entries.en: {v:006F}I... won't lose!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0070}ケッ！{n}言ってくれるぜ！
entries.en: ...{v:0070}Hah! You've got some nerve!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0071}間に合ったようだな。
entries.en: ...{v:0071}It seems I arrived in time.

entries.jp: {v:0072}ヴェンツェル様！
entries.en: {v:0072}Wenzel-sama!

entries.jp: {v:0073}ほう‥‥しばらく見なかった顔だな。{n}どの面下げて戻った、ヴェンツェル？
entries.en: {v:0073}Oh... A face I have not seen in some time. How dare you{n}show yourself here again, Wenzel?

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0074}なに、用事が済めばすぐに去る。{n}お前を倒し、ゲヴェルの野望に待ったをかけたらな。
entries.en: ...{v:0074}Oh, I shall leave as soon as my business is done. Once{n}I have defeated you and put a stop to{n}Gevel's ambitions.

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0075}なるほど、あくまでも、{n}あのお方に逆らうというのだな。{n}ならばここで殺してやる！
entries.en: ...{v:0075}I see. You intend to defy him to the bitter end. Then{n}I shall kill you here!

entries.jp: {v:0068}我々の計画を邪魔する者は、すべて消し去る。
entries.en: {v:0068}We will wipe out all who interfere with our plans.
